questions.question: A tank is 2,5 m × 1,2 m × 1,5 m. How many litres does it hold and how long does a 20 l/min pipe take to fill it?
Find the area to paint if the four sides and top of the tank are painted, and the paint needed for two coats at 10 m² per litre.
How many 10 × 6 × 20 cm cartons fit in a 60 × 30 × 40 cm crate? Why count along each edge?
questions.expected_answer: 6 × 5 × 2 = 60. Counting along edges only counts whole cartons that fit; dividing volumes can overcount when there are gaps.
